decisions.0: 主责全文读71唯一方法+19声明，3完整chunks；cap DoubleTag charge实际磁盘恢复→tick regen→BreakEvent实际consume→client镜像一业务owner1。不同于029世界XP与030chunk放置归属，不能将同项目视为重复，也不按charge字段/形状/网络支持另计。真正ID veind_data，源码全源rg确认VEIN_DATA vein_data在ObjectData datapack codec与PackGenerator配置生成中使用，CURRENT_CHARGE vein_charge只声明；二者没有玩家charge旧格式reader，不能虚构旧alias。attach所有Player但源码搜索无Clone，不能声称跨死亡保留；target/形状/maxblocks/healthair缓存均临时map不persist。reader getAsDouble/setCharge无范围/NaN guard，getCurrentCharge转int，consume按int快照回写导致小数丢失；尝试destroy先累计cost未检查成功回执，无费用退款。regen从int charge判断且else setCharge后packet再加fRate，客户端多显示一次rate；RATE条件与CAP optional绑定，tick phase使用&&使不是单纯每10tick。AOE含边角，TUNNEL预算先扣center再移除，无0坐标标记区分，limit包无clamp。只记录静态边界不称复现。余外datapack/具体装备数据/平台生命周期内部未展开；此运行能量不是本任务永久功名进度，借鉴审定所有者边界而不复制其瞬态map。

scope: 71 supplied full methods and19 declarations fully read in3 complete context chunks. Actual DoubleTag charge restore/regenerate/spend one owner; no aliases inferred from config-only vein_data or declaration-only vein_charge, no Clone proof, derived/cache/network supports no credit. Static only; no game, production or original save operations.
